candidates.name: LIDAR Composite DTM 10m
verified_facts: The EA 10m DTM is resampled from the 2m composite DTM using bilinear interpolation.
The contributing LIDAR surveys retain the stated +/-15cm RMSE vertical-accuracy contract.
semantic_limits: Coarsening to a 10m raster does not create a new vertical-accuracy guarantee and is unsuitable for pretending parcel-scale spatial detail that is absent from the grid.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite DTM 2017 - 25cm (retired)
verified_facts: EA marks the 25cm composite DTM as retired and no longer available as a current composite product, with a 1m version replacing it.
Historical 25cm time-stamped data remains available in the survey archive and the retired record retains the +/-15cm RMSE statement.
semantic_limits: Finer 25cm spatial resolution does not make a retired composite fresher or vertically more accurate than current products; exact survey date and lifecycle state must be retained.
